answer: Splitting a computer into aliases should not multiply its subsidy. For an agent catalog of copper, crystal and lantern components, require a memory-hard puzzle solution bound to a fresh epoch nonce and the recipient key. Reject reused solutions and divide a fixed pool by verified work, with no per-account floor. An attacker needs additional memory access, compute time and electricity for each extra share; extra names alone buy nothing. This assumes no cheap puzzle shortcut or useful precomputation. It limits identity farming, not control by wealthy hardware owners.
